text: {"danger_level":"yellow","danger_reason":"Very heavy rain of 150 mm in 24 hours is causing widespread waterlogging in several subways and low-lying parts of Chennai.","main_move":"STAY_ALERT","main_move_text":"Stay indoors on upper levels and stay prepared while supporting elderly persons and children.","where_to_go":"Stay where you are","do_now":[{"text":"Move elderly family members, children, and essential medical supplies to upper floors or elevated safe spots inside the house.","advice_ids":["ADV_EVAC_01"]},{"text":"Charge all mobile phones and emergency lanterns while electricity is available.","advice_ids":["ADV_PREP_02"]},{"text":"Store sufficient drinking water, dry food, and necessary daily medications for 24 to 48 hours.","advice_ids":["ADV_PREP_03"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not attempt to cross flooded roads, subways, or open drains with children or elderly people.","advice_ids":["ADV_DONT_01"]},{"text":"Do not touch electric poles, transformers, or submerged electrical points.","advice_ids":["ADV_DONT_02"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"In a ground-floor dwelling experiencing rising water","text":"Move immediately to a higher floor or seek assistance to reach a safe nearby community shelter before roads fill with water.","advice_ids":["ADV_SHELTER_01"]},{"situation":"Assisting individuals with limited mobility","text":"Keep wheelchairs, walking aids, and medical kits immediately accessible near the exit.","advice_ids":["ADV_MED_01"]}],"call":["1913","112","1077"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Location coordinates map to Kathivakkam in North Chennai, and disaster facts confirm heavy rain and urban waterlogging risks.","unknowns":["Immediate street-level water depth at your specific address in Kathivakkam."],"valid_while":["Valid during the ongoing heavy rain alert for the next 24 hours."]}
